req.title: Return 404 for unknown routes
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 for any path not matching a defined route.

doc.reasoning: R-HTTPBIN-036 requires that any path not matching a defined route returns HTTP 404. The violation was test[4] (test_root_subpath_unknown_returns_404) which had kind=negative but heuristic=EP. EP (Equivalence Partitioning) is a positive-class heuristic and must not be paired with kind=negative. Fix: change heuristic to NEG for that test, which correctly classifies it as a negative test using the NEG heuristic. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_unknown_path_returns_404
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Path /this-path-does-not-exist is not registered as a route
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Send GET request to /this-path-does-not-exist
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 404
trace: R-HTTPBIN-036: system shall respond with HTTP 404 for any path not matching a defined route
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/this-path-does-not-exist')
assert r.status_code == 404
assert r.status_code != 200

tests.name: test_known_route_does_not_return_404
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Path /get is a registered GET route
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Send GET request to /get
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-036: defined routes must NOT return 404 - validates the 404 logic is selective
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/get')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert r.status_code != 404

Send GET request to /gets (boundary: one char beyond known route /get)
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 404
trace: R-HTTPBIN-036: boundary - path one character longer than a real route must still return 404

client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/gets')
assert r.status_code == 404
assert r.status_code != 200
